A = sp.Matrix([[1, 1], [1, 2]])
u = sp.Matrix([2, 1])
print("输入:", list(u))
print("按行:", list(A*u))
print("第一列贡献:", list(u[0]*A[:, 0]))
print("第二列贡献:", list(u[1]*A[:, 1]))
print("线性组合:", list(u[0]*A[:, 0]+u[1]*A[:, 1]))
print("零输入:", list(A*sp.zeros(2, 1)))

A = sp.Matrix([[1, 1], [1, 2]])
B = sp.diag(1, 2)
u = sp.Matrix([2, 1])
print("AB:", (A*B).tolist())
print("BA:", (B*A).tolist())
print("先B后A:", list(A*(B*u)))
print("先A后B:", list(B*(A*u)))
print("单位矩阵:", sp.eye(2).tolist())

A = sp.Matrix([[1, 1], [1, 2]])
C = sp.Matrix([[1, 2], [1, 2]])
y = sp.Matrix([3, 4])
print("唯一解:", list(A.LUsolve(y)))
print("A的秩:", A.rank())
print("C的秩:", C.rank())
print("C与目标(3,4)的增广秩:", C.row_join(y).rank())
print("无解集合:", sp.linsolve((C, y)))
print("目标(4,4)的两组解:", list(C*sp.Matrix([4, 0])), list(C*sp.Matrix([2, 1])))
print("行列式:", A.det(), C.det())
print("逆矩阵:", A.inv().tolist())
print("逆乘原矩阵:", (A.inv()*A).tolist())
aug = A.row_join(y)
aug[1, :] = aug[1, :] - aug[0, :]
print("消元第一步:", aug.tolist())
aug[0, :] = aug[0, :] - aug[1, :]
print("消元第二步:", aug.tolist())
print("两列齐次方程:", sp.linsolve((A, sp.zeros(2, 1))))
print("相关列组合:", list(-2*C[:, 0]+C[:, 1]))
for target in (sp.Matrix([4, 4]), sp.Matrix([3, 4])):
    aug = C.row_join(target)
    aug[1, :] = aug[1, :] - aug[0, :]
    print("C消元:", aug.tolist())
a, b, c, d = sp.symbols('a b c d')
M = sp.Matrix([[a, b], [c, d]])
candidate = sp.Matrix([[d, -b], [-c, a]])/(a*d-b*c)
print("逆公式乘回:", sp.simplify(candidate*M).tolist())

A = sp.Matrix([[1, 1], [1, 2]])
B = sp.diag(1, 2)
C = sp.Matrix([[1, 2], [1, 2]])
p, q = sp.Matrix([1, 2]), sp.Matrix([3, 4])
print("正文内积/范数/外积:", p.dot(q), p.norm(), (p*q.T).tolist())
print("正文输出长度:", q.norm())
print("题1:", list(A*sp.Matrix([-1, 2])))
print("题1列贡献:", list(-A[:, 0]), list(2*A[:, 1]))
print("题2:", (A*B).tolist(), (B*A).tolist())
print("题3:", list(A.LUsolve(sp.Matrix([5, 8]))))
r = sp.symbols('r', real=True)
print("题4全部解核验:", list(C*sp.Matrix([6-2*r, r])))
print("题4增广秩:", C.row_join(sp.Matrix([6, 6])).rank(), C.row_join(sp.Matrix([6, 5])).rank())
print("题5:", A.inv().tolist(), (A.inv()*A).tolist())
p, q = sp.Matrix([1, -1]), sp.Matrix([1, 1])
print("题6:", p.dot(q), p.norm(), (p*q.T).tolist())
F, G = sp.Matrix([[1, 1], [0, 1]]), sp.Matrix([0, 1])
print("正文状态更新:", list(F*sp.Matrix([2, 1])+G*(-1)))
print("正文状态两项:", list(F*sp.Matrix([2, 1])), list(G*(-1)))
print("题7:", list(F*sp.Matrix([1, 2])+G*(-2)))
print("题7两项:", list(F*sp.Matrix([1, 2])), list(G*(-2)))
M = sp.Matrix([[1, 2], [3, 4]])
print("转置示例:", M.T.tolist())
print("二维逆公式核验:", (A.inv()*sp.Matrix([3, 4])).T.tolist())
